text: Before a dental or a big workup, families want to know the cost. An estimate tells them in writing.
Estimates live on the client, under the ledger. Maria has none yet.
An estimate is a quote. Nothing is charged or held.
In Charge to, pick the pet.
Search for an item, just like on a bill.
The total updates as you add.
Read the email over, and edit it if you like.
Click Save estimate to close it.
It's listed here with its status, so you can see where it stands. The statuses are Draft, Sent, Accepted, Declined, Converted or Expired.

The most common mistakes are telling a family their card is held for an estimate, when only euthanasia estimates hold a card, and quoting from memory instead of making an estimate. Remember: an estimate is a quote, not a bill. Nothing is charged or held, and the family pays at checkout.
